scientific_integrity: Exact analysis follows the complete facet-sign partition and spherical integration; finite numerical calculations are supplementary diagnostics, not a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the equal-edge square antiprism is covered; an arbitrary-height twisted square prism has a different law.
Exceptional normals on finitely many great circles are excluded from the almost-sure four-point support.
No independent historical-priority review or independent audit has been performed.
title: Exact four-point shadow-polygon law of the uniform square antiprism
